pma10_1_contract.text:
def pma10_1_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ n (C : Cell n) (f : Coord n → ℝ), ContinuousOn f C.carrier →
    IteratedRIntegrable C f) ∧
  (∀ n (C : Cell (n + 1)) (f : Coord (n + 1) → ℝ), ContinuousOn f C.carrier →
    ContinuousOn (nativeSliceIntegral C f) C.init.carrier) ∧
  (∀ n (C : Cell (n + 1)) (f : Coord (n + 1) → ℝ),
    iteratedRIntegral C f = iteratedRIntegral C.init (nativeSliceIntegral C f)) ∧
  (∀ n (C : Cell n) (f : Coord n → ℝ), ContinuousOn f C.carrier →
    IntegrableOn f C.carrier ∧ iteratedRIntegral C f = ∫ x in C.carrier, f x)

pma10_2_contract.text:
def pma10_2_contract : Prop :=
  ∀ n (C : Cell n) (f : Coord n → ℝ), ContinuousOn f C.carrier →
    ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n),
      IteratedRIntegrable (C.permute σ) (fun x => f (unpermute σ x)) ∧
      iteratedRIntegral (C.permute σ) (fun x => f (unpermute σ x)) = iteratedRIntegral C f

pma10_3_contract.text:
def pma10_3_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ n (f : Coord n → ℝ), tsupport f = closure {x | f x ≠ 0}) ∧
  (∀ n (f : Coord n → ℂ), tsupport f = closure {x | f x ≠ 0}) ∧
  (∀ n (f : Coord n → ℝ), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f →
    (∃ C : Cell n, tsupport f ⊆ C.carrier) ∧ Integrable f ∧
    wholeRIntegral f = ∫ x, f x) ∧
  (∀ n (f : Coord n → ℝ) (C : Cell n), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f →
    tsupport f ⊆ C.carrier → IteratedRIntegrable C f ∧
      wholeRIntegral f = iteratedRIntegral C f) ∧
  (∀ n (f : Coord n → ℂ), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f →
    (∃ C : Cell n, tsupport f ⊆ C.carrier) ∧ Integrable f ∧
    complexWholeRIntegral f = ∫ x, f x) ∧
  (∀ n (f : Coord n → ℂ) (C : Cell n), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f →
    tsupport f ⊆ C.carrier → ComplexIteratedRIntegrable C f ∧
      complexWholeRIntegral f = complexIteratedRIntegral C f)

pma10_4_contract.text:
def pma10_4_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ n (f : Coord n → ℝ), ContinuousOn f (standardSimplex n) →
    IteratedRIntegrable (Cell.unit n) (simplexExtension f) ∧
    IntegrableOn f (standardSimplex n) ∧
    simplexRIntegral f = ∫ x in standardSimplex n, f x) ∧
  (∀ n (f : Coord (n + 1) → ℝ), ContinuousOn f (standardSimplex (n + 1)) →
    ContinuousOn (nativeSliceIntegral (Cell.unit (n + 1)) (simplexExtension f))
      (Cell.unit n).carrier) ∧
  (∀ n (f : Coord n → ℝ), ContinuousOn f (standardSimplex n) →
    ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n),
      IteratedRIntegrable (Cell.unit n) (fun x => simplexExtension f (unpermute σ x)) ∧
      iteratedRIntegral (Cell.unit n) (fun x => simplexExtension f (unpermute σ x)) =
        simplexRIntegral f)

pma10_5_contract.text:
def pma10_5_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (m : Fin n) (g : Euclidean n → ℝ) (x : Euclidean n) (i : Fin n),
    primitiveMap m g x i = if i = m then g x else x i) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (G : Euclidean n → Euclidean n) (E : Set (Euclidean n)),
    IsPrimitiveOn G E ↔ ∃ m : Fin n, ∃ g : Euclidean n → ℝ, ∀ x ∈ E,
      G x = (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase m, x i • coordinateVector n i) +
        g x • coordinateVector n m) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (m : Fin n) (g : Euclidean n → ℝ) (a : Euclidean n),
    DifferentiableAt ℝ g a →
    HasFDerivAt (primitiveMap m g)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclidean n) +
        (fderiv ℝ g a - EuclideanSpace.proj m).smulRight (coordinateVector n m)) a ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin n, operatorMatrix (fderiv ℝ (primitiveMap m g) a) i j =
      if i = m then coordinatePartial g a j else if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧
    jacobian (primitiveMap m g) a = coordinatePartial g a m ∧
    ((fderiv ℝ (primitiveMap m g) a).IsInvertible ↔ coordinatePartial g a m ≠ 0))

pma10_6_contract.text:
def pma10_6_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (i j k : Fin n) (x : Euclidean n),
    flipOperator i j x k = x (Equiv.swap i j k)) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (B : Operator n n), IsFlip B ↔
    ∃ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j ∧ ∀ k : Fin n,
      B (coordinateVector n k) = coordinateVector n (Equiv.swap i j k)) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin n),
    (flipOperator i j).comp (flipOperator i j) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclidean n)) ∧
  (∀ (n m : ℕ) (x : Euclidean n) (i : Fin n),
    prefixProjection n m x i = if i.val < m then x i else 0) ∧
  (∀ n : ℕ, prefixProjection n 0 = 0 ∧
    prefixProjection n n = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclidean n)) ∧
  (∀ (n m : ℕ), m ≤ n →
    (prefixProjection n m).toLinearMap.range =
      Submodule.span ℝ (coordinateVector n '' {i : Fin n | i.val < m}) ∧
    (prefixProjection n m).toLinearMap.ker =
      Submodule.span ℝ (coordinateVector n '' {i : Fin n | m ≤ i.val}))

pma10_7_contract.text:
def pma10_7_contract : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (F : Euclidean n → Euclidean n),
    IsOpen E → (0 : Euclidean n) ∈ E → C1On F E → F 0 = 0 →
    (fderiv ℝ F 0).IsInvertible →
    ∃ (G : List (Euclidean n → Euclidean n)) (B : List (Operator n n))
      (U : Set (Euclidean n)),
      G.length = n ∧ B.length = n - 1 ∧
      (∀ g ∈ G, PrimitiveNearZero g) ∧
      (∀ b ∈ B, IsFlip b ∨ b = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclidean n)) ∧
      IsOpen U ∧ (0 : Euclidean n) ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ E ∧
      EqOn F (composeMaps ((B.map (fun (b : Operator n n) =>
        (b : Euclidean n → Euclidean n))) ++ G)) U

pma10_8_contract.text:
def pma10_8_contract : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (ι : Type) (K : Set (Euclidean n)) (V : ι → Set (Euclidean n)),
    IsCompact K → (∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) → K ⊆ ⋃ i, V i →
    ∃ (s : Finset ι) (ψ : s → C(Euclidean n, ℝ)),
      (∀ i x, ψ i x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      (∀ i, tsupport (ψ i) ⊆ V i) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ∑ i, ψ i x = 1) ∧
      (∀ f : C(Euclidean n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ K →
        (∀ x, f x = ∑ i, ψ i x * f x) ∧
        ∀ i, Continuous (fun x => ψ i x * f x) ∧
          tsupport (fun x => ψ i x * f x) ⊆ V i)

pma10_9_contract.text:
def pma10_9_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (T : Coord n → Coord n) (x : Coord n),
    coordinateJacobian T x = Matrix.det (LinearMap.toMatrix' (fderiv ℝ T x).toLinearMap)) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (T : Coord n → Coord n) (x : Coord n), DifferentiableAt ℝ T x →
    jacobian (euclideanTransform T) (coordEquivEuclidean n x) = coordinateJacobian T x) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Coord n)) (T : Coord n → Coord n) (f : Coord n → ℝ),
    IsOpen E → C1On T E → InjOn T E →
    (∀ x ∈ E, coordinateJacobian T x ≠ 0) →
    Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ T '' E →
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Coord n) (Coord n),
      (e : Coord n → Coord n) = T ∧ e.source = E ∧ e.target = T '' E ∧
      IsOpen (T '' E) ∧ ContinuousOn e.symm (T '' E) ∧
      Continuous (zeroExtendedPullback E T f) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (zeroExtendedPullback E T f) ∧
      tsupport (zeroExtendedPullback E T f) ⊆ E ∧
      IteratedRIntegrable (supportCell f) f ∧
      IteratedRIntegrable (supportCell (zeroExtendedPullback E T f))
        (zeroExtendedPullback E T f) ∧
      wholeRIntegral f = wholeRIntegral (zeroExtendedPullback E T f))

pma10_10_contract.text:
def pma10_10_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (k : ℕ) (D : ParameterDomain k), IsCompact D.carrier) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)), IsOpen E → ∀ Φ : Surface k n E,
    ∃ U : Set (Coord k), IsOpen U ∧ Φ.domain.carrier ⊆ U ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ.map U ∧ MapsTo Φ.map Φ.domain.carrier E) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)), IsOpen E →
    ∀ (D : ParameterDomain k) (f : Coord k → Euclidean n) (U : Set (Coord k)),
    IsOpen U → D.carrier ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → MapsTo f D.carrier E →
    ∃ Φ : Surface k n E, Φ.domain = D ∧ Φ.map = f) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)), IsOpen E → ∀ γ : RegularCurve n E,
    γ.toSurface.domain = .cell (intervalCell γ.lower γ.upper γ.ordered) ∧
      γ.toSurface.map = (fun x => γ.map (x 0)) ∧ γ.toSurface.toCurve.map = γ.map) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)), IsOpen E → ∀ Φ : Surface 1 n E,
    Φ.toCurve.lower = Φ.domain.interval.1 ∧ Φ.toCurve.upper = Φ.domain.interval.2 ∧
      Φ.toCurve.map = (fun t => Φ.map (fun _ => t)) ∧
      Φ.toCurve.toSurface.map = Φ.map)

pma10_11_contract.text:
def pma10_11_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (Φ : Surface k n E) (ω : FormField n),
    IsFormOn E k ω → ContinuousOn (surfaceIntegrand Φ ω) Φ.domain.carrier ∧
      Φ.domain.Integrable (surfaceIntegrand Φ ω)) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n))
    (a : (Fin k → Fin n) → Euclidean n → ℝ),
    (∀ I, ContinuousOn (a I) E) → IsFormOn E k (formFromCoefficients a) ∧
      ∀ Φ : Surface k n E, surfaceIntegral Φ (formFromCoefficients a) =
        Φ.domain.integral (fun u => ∑ I, a I (Φ.map u) *
          Matrix.det (fun i j => (fderiv ℝ Φ.map u (Pi.single j 1)) (I i)))) ∧
  (∀ (r k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n))
    (a : (Fin k → Fin n) → Euclidean n → ℝ),
    (∀ I, ContDiffOn ℝ r (a I) E) → IsCFormOn r E k (formFromCoefficients a)) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (f : Euclidean n → ℝ),
    ContinuousOn f E → IsFormOn E 0 (scalarForm f)) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n), IsFormOn E 0 ω →
    ∃ f : Euclidean n → ℝ, ContinuousOn f E ∧ EqOn (scalarForm f) ω E ∧
      ∀ g : Euclidean n → ℝ, EqOn (scalarForm g) ω E → EqOn g f E) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (Φ : Surface 0 n E) (f : Euclidean n → ℝ),
    surfaceIntegral Φ (scalarForm f) = f (Φ.map 0))

pma10_12_contract.text:
def pma10_12_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ Φ : Surface 1 3 univ, Φ.domain = .cell (Cell.unit 1) →
    IteratedRIntegrable (Cell.unit 1) (surfaceIntegrand Φ xyDifferential) ∧
    surfaceIntegral Φ xyDifferential =
      Φ.map 1 0 * Φ.map 1 1 - Φ.map 0 0 * Φ.map 0 1 ∧
    (Φ.map 0 = Φ.map 1 → surfaceIntegral Φ xyDifferential = 0)) ∧
  (∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < b → ∃ Φ : Surface 1 2 univ,
    Φ.domain = .cell ellipseCell ∧ Φ.map = ellipseMap a b ∧
    Φ.map 0 = Φ.map (fun _ => 2 * Real.pi) ∧
    IteratedRIntegrable ellipseCell (surfaceIntegrand Φ (coordinateOneForm 0 1)) ∧
    IteratedRIntegrable ellipseCell (surfaceIntegrand Φ (coordinateOneForm 1 0)) ∧
    surfaceIntegral Φ (coordinateOneForm 0 1) = Real.pi * a * b ∧
    surfaceIntegral Φ (coordinateOneForm 1 0) = -(Real.pi * a * b)) ∧
  (∃ Φ : Surface 3 3 univ,
    Φ.domain = .cell sphericalCell ∧ Φ.map = sphericalMap ∧
    (∀ u, sphericalJacobian u = (u 0)^2 * Real.sin (u 1)) ∧
    IteratedRIntegrable sphericalCell (surfaceIntegrand Φ volumeForm) ∧
    surfaceIntegral Φ volumeForm = 4 * Real.pi / 3 ∧
    sphericalMap '' sphericalCell.carrier = Metric.closedBall 0 1 ∧
    InjOn sphericalMap (interior sphericalCell.carrier))

pma10_13_contract.text:
def pma10_13_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (n k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω η : FormField n),
    FormEqOn E k ω η ↔ ∀ Φ : Surface k n E, surfaceIntegral Φ ω = surfaceIntegral Φ η) ∧
  (∀ (n k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n),
    FormEqOn E k ω 0 ↔ ∀ Φ : Surface k n E, surfaceIntegral Φ ω = 0) ∧
  (∀ (n k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω η : FormField n) (c : ℝ),
    IsFormOn E k ω → IsFormOn E k η → ∀ Φ : Surface k n E,
    surfaceIntegral Φ (c • ω + η) = c * surfaceIntegral Φ ω + surfaceIntegral Φ η) ∧
  (∀ (n k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (f : Euclidean n → ℝ) (I : Fin k → Fin n)
    (i j : Fin k), i ≠ j →
    FormEqOn E k (coefficientWedge f (I ∘ Equiv.swap i j)) (-coefficientWedge f I)) ∧
  (∀ (n k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (f : Euclidean n → ℝ) (I : Fin k → Fin n)
    (i j : Fin k), i ≠ j → I i = I j → FormEqOn E k (coefficientWedge f I) 0) ∧
  (∀ (n k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n),
    n < k → IsFormOn E k ω → EqOn ω 0 E ∧ FormEqOn E k ω 0)

pma10_14_contract.text:
def pma10_14_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ n k : ℕ, Nat.card (StandardIndex n k) = n.choose k) ∧
  (∀ (n k : ℕ) (I : Fin k → Fin n), StrictMono I → ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),
    tupleSign (fun j => ((I (σ j)).val : ℤ)) = (σ.sign : ℤ)) ∧
  (∀ (n k : ℕ) (I : Fin k → Fin n), Injective I → ∃ S : StandardIndex n k,
    range (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S) = range I ∧
    coordinateWedge I = (tupleSign (fun j => ((I j).val : ℤ)) : ℝ) • standardWedge S) ∧
  (∀ (n k : ℕ) (I : Fin k → Fin n) (i j : Fin k), i ≠ j → I i = I j →
    coordinateWedge I = 0) ∧
  (∀ (n k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n), IsFormOn E k ω →
    (∀ S : StandardIndex n k, ContinuousOn (formCoefficient ω S.val) E) ∧
    ∀ x ∈ E, ω x = ∑ S : StandardIndex n k, formCoefficient ω S.val x • standardWedge S) ∧
  (∀ (n k r : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n), IsCFormOn r E k ω →
    (∀ S : StandardIndex n k, ContDiffOn ℝ r (formCoefficient ω S.val) E) ∧
    ∀ x ∈ E, ω x = ∑ S : StandardIndex n k, formCoefficient ω S.val x • standardWedge S) ∧
  coordinateWedge (![0, 4, 2, 1] : Fin 4 → Fin 5) =
    -coordinateWedge (![0, 1, 2, 4] : Fin 4 → Fin 5) ∧
  coordinateWedge (![3, 1, 2] : Fin 3 → Fin 4) =
    coordinateWedge (![1, 2, 3] : Fin 3 → Fin 4) ∧
  rawTwoForm = standardTwoForm

pma10_15_contract.text:
def pma10_15_contract : Prop :=
  ∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n),
    IsOpen E → IsFormOn E k ω →
      (FormEqOn E k ω 0 ↔ ∀ S : StandardIndex n k, ∀ x ∈ E, formCoefficient ω S.val x = 0) ∧
      (FormEqOn E k ω 0 ↔ EqOn ω 0 E)

pma10_16_contract.text:
def pma10_16_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (n p q : ℕ) (I : Fin p → Fin n) (J : Fin q → Fin n),
    coordinateWedge I * coordinateWedge J = coordinateWedge (Fin.append I J)) ∧
  (∀ (n p q : ℕ) (S : StandardIndex n p) (T : StandardIndex n q),
    ¬Disjoint S.val T.val → standardWedge S * standardWedge T = 0) ∧
  (∀ (n p q : ℕ) (S : StandardIndex n p) (T : StandardIndex n q)
      (h : Disjoint S.val T.val),
    standardWedge S * standardWedge T =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ crossInversionCount (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S)
        (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm T) • standardWedge (Set.powersetCard.disjUnion h)) ∧
  (∀ (n p q r : ℕ) (S : StandardIndex n p) (T : StandardIndex n q) (U : StandardIndex n r),
    (standardWedge S * standardWedge T) * standardWedge U =
      standardWedge S * (standardWedge T * standardWedge U))

pma10_17_contract.text:
def pma10_17_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (n p q : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω η : FormField n),
    IsFormOn E p ω → IsFormOn E q η → IsFormOn E (p + q) (wedge ω η) ∧
    ∀ x ∈ E, wedge ω η x =
      ∑ S : StandardIndex n p, ∑ T : StandardIndex n q,
        (formCoefficient ω S.val x * formCoefficient η T.val x) • (standardWedge S * standardWedge T)) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (ω η θ : FormField n), wedge (ω + η) θ = wedge ω θ + wedge η θ ∧
    wedge ω (η + θ) = wedge ω η + wedge ω θ ∧
    wedge (wedge ω η) θ = wedge ω (wedge η θ)) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Euclidean n → ℝ) (ω : FormField n),
    wedge (scalarForm f) ω = (fun x => f x • ω x) ∧
    wedge ω (scalarForm f) = (fun x => f x • ω x)) ∧
  (∀ (n p q : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω η : FormField n),
    IsFormOn E p ω → IsFormOn E q η →
    EqOn (wedge ω η) ((-1 : ℝ)^(p*q) • wedge η ω) E)

pma10_18_contract.text:
def pma10_18_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (n k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n),
    IsOpen E → IsCFormOn 1 E k ω → IsFormOn E (k + 1) (exteriorDerivative ω) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ E, exteriorDerivative ω x =
        ∑ S : StandardIndex n k, scalarDifferential (formCoefficient ω S.val) x * standardWedge S) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Euclidean n → ℝ), exteriorDerivative (scalarForm f) = scalarDifferential f) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (f : Euclidean n → ℝ),
    IsOpen E → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f E → ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ v : Fin 1 → Euclidean n,
      evaluateForm 1 v (scalarDifferential f x) = fderiv ℝ f x (v 0))

pma10_19_contract.text:
def pma10_19_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (f : Euclidean n → ℝ),
    IsOpen E → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f E → ∀ Φ : Surface 1 n E,
      Φ.domain.Integrable (surfaceIntegrand Φ (scalarDifferential f)) ∧
      surfaceIntegral Φ (scalarDifferential f) =
        f (Φ.map (fun _ => Φ.domain.interval.2)) - f (Φ.map (fun _ => Φ.domain.interval.1))) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (f : Euclidean n → ℝ),
    IsOpen E → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f E → ∀ Φ Ψ : Surface 1 n E,
      Φ.map (fun _ => Φ.domain.interval.1) = Ψ.map (fun _ => Ψ.domain.interval.1) →
      Φ.map (fun _ => Φ.domain.interval.2) = Ψ.map (fun _ => Ψ.domain.interval.2) →
      surfaceIntegral Φ (scalarDifferential f) = surfaceIntegral Ψ (scalarDifferential f)) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (f : Euclidean n → ℝ),
    IsOpen E → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f E → ∀ Φ : Surface 1 n E,
      Φ.map (fun _ => Φ.domain.interval.1) = Φ.map (fun _ => Φ.domain.interval.2) →
      surfaceIntegral Φ (scalarDifferential f) = 0) ∧
  (¬ ∃ f : Euclidean 2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 f ∧
    EqOn (scalarDifferential f) (coordinateOneForm 0 1) univ)

pma10_20_contract.text:
def pma10_20_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (n k m : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω η : FormField n),
    IsOpen E → IsCFormOn 1 E k ω → IsCFormOn 1 E m η →
      EqOn (exteriorDerivative (wedge ω η))
        (wedge (exteriorDerivative ω) η + ((-1 : ℝ) ^ k) • wedge ω (exteriorDerivative η)) E) ∧
  (∀ (n k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n),
    IsOpen E → IsCFormOn 2 E k ω → IsCFormOn 1 E (k + 1) (exteriorDerivative ω) ∧
      EqOn (exteriorDerivative (exteriorDerivative ω)) 0 E)

pma10_21_contract.text:
def pma10_21_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (n m k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (V : Set (Euclidean m))
    (T : Euclidean n → Euclidean m) (ω : FormField m),
    IsOpen E → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 T E → MapsTo T E V → IsFormOn V k ω →
      IsFormOn E k (pullbackForm T ω)) ∧
  (∀ (n m k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (T : Euclidean n → Euclidean m)
    (a : (Fin k → Fin m) → Euclidean m → ℝ), IsOpen E → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 T E →
    ∀ x ∈ E, pullbackForm T (formFromCoefficients a) x =
      ∑ I, a I (T x) • (List.ofFn fun j => scalarDifferential (fun y => T y (I j)) x).prod) ∧
  (∀ (n m : ℕ) (T : Euclidean n → Euclidean m) (f : Euclidean m → ℝ),
    pullbackForm T (scalarForm f) = scalarForm (f ∘ T))

pma10_22_contract.text:
def pma10_22_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (n m : ℕ) (T : Euclidean n → Euclidean m) (ω η : FormField m),
    pullbackForm T (ω + η) = pullbackForm T ω + pullbackForm T η ∧
    pullbackForm T (wedge ω η) = wedge (pullbackForm T ω) (pullbackForm T η)) ∧
  (∀ (n m k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (V : Set (Euclidean m))
    (T : Euclidean n → Euclidean m) (ω : FormField m),
    IsOpen E → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 T E → MapsTo T E V → IsCFormOn 1 V k ω →
      IsCFormOn 1 E k (pullbackForm T ω) ∧
      EqOn (exteriorDerivative (pullbackForm T ω)) (pullbackForm T (exteriorDerivative ω)) E)

pma10_23_contract.text:
def pma10_23_contract : Prop :=
  ∀ (n m p k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (V : Set (Euclidean m))
    (W : Set (Euclidean p)) (T : Euclidean n → Euclidean m)
    (S : Euclidean m → Euclidean p) (ω : FormField p),
    IsOpen E → IsOpen V → IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 T E → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 S V →
    MapsTo T E V → MapsTo S V W → IsFormOn W k ω →
      EqOn (pullbackForm (S ∘ T) ω) (pullbackForm T (pullbackForm S ω)) E

pma10_24_contract.text:
def pma10_24_contract : Prop :=
  ∀ (n k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (Φ : Surface k n E) (ω : FormField n),
    IsOpen E → IsFormOn E k ω →
      Φ.domain.Integrable (surfaceIntegrand Φ ω) ∧
      Φ.domain.Integrable (surfaceIntegrand (identityParameterSurface Φ.domain)
        (pullbackForm Φ.euclideanMap ω)) ∧
      surfaceIntegral Φ ω = surfaceIntegral (identityParameterSurface Φ.domain)
        (pullbackForm Φ.euclideanMap ω)

pma10_25_contract.text:
def pma10_25_contract : Prop :=
  ∀ (n m k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (V : Set (Euclidean m))
    (T : Euclidean n → Euclidean m) (Φ : Surface k n E) (ω : FormField m)
    (hE : IsOpen E) (hV : IsOpen V) (hT : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 T E) (hTV : MapsTo T E V),
    IsFormOn V k ω →
      (Φ.mapBy T hE hT hTV).domain = Φ.domain ∧
      (Φ.mapBy T hE hT hTV).map = T ∘ Φ.map ∧
      Φ.domain.Integrable (surfaceIntegrand (Φ.mapBy T hE hT hTV) ω) ∧
      Φ.domain.Integrable (surfaceIntegrand Φ (pullbackForm T ω)) ∧
      surfaceIntegral (Φ.mapBy T hE hT hTV) ω = surfaceIntegral Φ (pullbackForm T ω)

pma10_26_contract.text:
def pma10_26_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (X Y : Type*) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℝ X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module ℝ Y]
      (f : X → Y),
    (∃ F : X →ᵃ[ℝ] Y, (F : X → Y) = f) ↔
      ∃ A : X →ₗ[ℝ] Y, ∀ x, f x = f 0 + A x) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (F : Coord k →ᵃ[ℝ] Euclidean n) (u : Coord k),
    F u = F 0 + F.linear u ∧
    F u = affineSimplexMap (Fin.cons (F 0) (fun i => F (Pi.single i 1))) u) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (F G : Coord k →ᵃ[ℝ] Euclidean n), F 0 = G 0 →
    (∀ i : Fin k, F (Pi.single i 1) = G (Pi.single i 1)) → F = G) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (p : Fin (k + 1) → Euclidean n),
    affineSimplexMap p 0 = p 0 ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, affineSimplexMap p (Pi.single i 1) = p i.succ) ∧
    (∀ u : Coord k, affineSimplexMap p u = p 0 + ∑ i, u i • (p i.succ - p 0)) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (affineSimplexMap p) ∧
    (∀ u : Coord k, HasFDerivAt (affineSimplexMap p) (affineSimplexLinear p) u)) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (p : Fin (n + 1) → Euclidean n) (x : Euclidean n),
    jacobian (affineSimplexMap p ∘ (coordEquivEuclidean n).symm) x =
      columnDet (fun i : Fin n => p i.succ - p 0)) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (p : Fin (n + 1) → Euclidean n),
    LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i : Fin n => p i.succ - p 0) →
      columnDet (fun i : Fin n => p i.succ - p 0) ≠ 0 ∧
      (AffinePositiveOrientation p ∨ AffineNegativeOrientation p) ∧
      ∀ x : Euclidean n,
        (fderiv ℝ (affineSimplexMap p ∘ (coordEquivEuclidean n).symm) x).IsInvertible) ∧
  (∀ n : ℕ,
    affineSimplexMap (fun i => coordEquivEuclidean n (standardVertex n i)) = coordEquivEuclidean n ∧
    AffinePositiveOrientation (fun i => coordEquivEuclidean n (standardVertex n i))) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (p : Fin 1 → Euclidean n)
    (hp : MapsTo (affineSimplexMap p) (standardSimplex 0) E) (ε : ℤˣ) (f : Euclidean n → ℝ),
    signedAffineIntegral ε p hp (scalarForm f) = (ε : ℤ) * f (p 0))

pma10_27_contract.text:
def pma10_27_contract : Prop :=
  ∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (p : Fin (k + 1) → Euclidean n)
    (hp : MapsTo (affineSimplexMap p) (standardSimplex k) E)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (k + 1))) (ω : FormField n),
    IsOpen E → IsFormOn E k ω →
    ∃ hq : MapsTo (affineSimplexMap (p ∘ σ)) (standardSimplex k) E,
      ParameterDomain.Integrable .simplex (surfaceIntegrand (affineSimplexSurface p hp) ω) ∧
      ParameterDomain.Integrable .simplex (surfaceIntegrand (affineSimplexSurface (p ∘ σ) hq) ω) ∧
      surfaceIntegral (affineSimplexSurface (p ∘ σ) hq) ω =
        (σ.sign : ℤ) * surfaceIntegral (affineSimplexSurface p hp) ω

pma10_28_contract.text:
def pma10_28_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (k n N : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (σ : Fin N → AffineSimplexIn k n E)
    (z : Fin N → ℤ) (ω : FormField n),
    affineChainIntegral ω (∑ i, Finsupp.single (σ i) (z i)) =
      ∑ i, (z i : ℝ) * surfaceIntegral (affineSimplexSurface (σ i).vertices (σ i).mapsTo) ω) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (Γ Δ : AffineChain k n E) (z : ℤ) (ω : FormField n),
    affineChainIntegral ω (Γ + Δ) = affineChainIntegral ω Γ + affineChainIntegral ω Δ ∧
    affineChainIntegral ω (z • Γ) = (z : ℝ) * affineChainIntegral ω Γ ∧
    affineChainIntegral ω (Γ - Γ) = 0) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (Γ Δ : AffineChain k n E),
    AffineChainEq Γ Δ ↔ ∀ ω : FormField n, IsFormOn E k ω →
      affineChainIntegral ω Γ = affineChainIntegral ω Δ) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (Γ : AffineChain k n E) (ω : FormField n),
    chainIntegral ω (affineChainToSimplex Γ) = affineChainIntegral ω Γ)

pma10_29_contract.text:
def pma10_29_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (σ : AffineSimplexIn (k + 1) n E),
    affineChainBoundary (Finsupp.single σ 1) =
      ∑ i : Fin (k + 2), ((-1 : ℤ)^i.val) • Finsupp.single (σ.face i) 1) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (σ : AffineSimplexIn (k + 1) n E)
    (i : Fin (k + 2)),
    (σ.face i).vertices = σ.vertices ∘ i.succAbove ∧
    (σ.face i).toC2 = σ.toC2.face i) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (σ : AffineSimplexIn (k + 1) n E)
    (u : Coord k),
    affineSimplexMap (σ.face 0).vertices u =
      σ.vertices 1 + ∑ j : Fin k, u j • (σ.vertices j.succ.succ - σ.vertices 1)) ∧
  (∀ (k : ℕ) (i : Fin (k + 1)) (u : Coord k),
    standardFaceMap i.succ u = Fin.insertNth i 0 u) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (σ : AffineSimplexIn 2 n E),
    affineSimplexBoundary σ = Finsupp.single (σ.face 0) 1 -
      Finsupp.single (σ.face 1) 1 + Finsupp.single (σ.face 2) 1) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (Γ : AffineChain (k + 1) n E),
    affineChainToSimplex (affineChainBoundary Γ) = chainBoundary (affineChainToSimplex Γ))

pma10_30_contract.text:
def pma10_30_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (k n m : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (V : Set (Euclidean m))
    (σ : C2Simplex k n E) (T : Euclidean n → Euclidean m)
    (hE : IsOpen E) (hV : IsOpen V) (hT : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 T E) (hTV : MapsTo T E V),
    (σ.mapBy T hE hT hTV).map = T ∘ σ.map ∧
    (σ.mapBy T hE hT hTV).toSurface.IsC2 ∧
    ∀ (ω : FormField m), IsFormOn V k ω →
      (ParameterDomain.simplex : ParameterDomain k).Integrable
        (surfaceIntegrand (σ.mapBy T hE hT hTV).toSurface ω) ∧
      (ParameterDomain.simplex : ParameterDomain k).Integrable
        (surfaceIntegrand σ.toSurface (pullbackForm T ω)) ∧
      surfaceIntegral (σ.mapBy T hE hT hTV).toSurface ω =
        surfaceIntegral σ.toSurface (pullbackForm T ω)) ∧
  (∀ (k n m : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (V : Set (Euclidean m))
    (Γ Δ : SimplexChain k n E) (z : ℤ) (T : Euclidean n → Euclidean m)
    (hE : IsOpen E) (hT : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 T E) (hTV : MapsTo T E V),
    chainMap T hE hT hTV (Γ + Δ) = chainMap T hE hT hTV Γ + chainMap T hE hT hTV Δ ∧
    chainMap T hE hT hTV (z • Γ) = z • chainMap T hE hT hTV Γ) ∧
  (∀ (k n m : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (V : Set (Euclidean m))
    (Γ : SimplexChain (k + 1) n E) (T : Euclidean n → Euclidean m)
    (hE : IsOpen E) (hT : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 T E) (hTV : MapsTo T E V),
    chainBoundary (chainMap T hE hT hTV Γ) = chainMap T hE hT hTV (chainBoundary Γ)) ∧
  (∀ (k n m : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (V : Set (Euclidean m))
    (σ : AffineSimplexIn (k + 1) n E) (F : Euclidean n →ᵃ[ℝ] Euclidean m)
    (hE : IsOpen E) (hFV : MapsTo F E V),
    (σ.mapAffine F hFV).toC2 = σ.toC2.mapBy F hE
      (affineMap_euclidean_contDiff F 2).contDiffOn hFV ∧
    simplexBoundary (σ.toC2.mapBy F hE (affineMap_euclidean_contDiff F 2).contDiffOn hFV) =
      affineChainToSimplex (affineSimplexBoundary (σ.mapAffine F hFV)))

positiveBoundary_contract.text:
def positiveBoundary_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (P : PositiveSimplex n E),
    IsOpen P.openCarrier ∧ closure P.openCarrier = P.carrier ∧
      ∀ u ∈ standardSimplex n, 0 ≤ coordinateJacobian P.simplex.coordinateMap u) ∧
  (∀ (d : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean (d + 1))) (P : PositiveSimplex (d + 1) E),
    P.boundary = ∑ i : Fin (d + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val • Finsupp.single (P.simplex.face i) 1 ∧
      ∀ (ω : FormField (d + 1)), IsFormOn E d ω → ∀ i : Fin (d + 2),
        (ParameterDomain.simplex : ParameterDomain d).Integrable
          (surfaceIntegrand (P.simplex.face i).toSurface ω)) ∧
  (∀ (d : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean (d + 1))) (P Q : PositiveSimplex (d + 1) E),
    IsOpen E → P.carrier = Q.carrier → ChainEq P.boundary Q.boundary) ∧
  (∀ (d : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean (d + 1))) (R : PositiveRegion (d + 1) E),
    R.boundary = ∑ i, (R.piece i).boundary ∧
      ∀ ω : FormField (d + 1), IsFormOn E d ω →
        chainIntegral ω R.boundary = ∑ i, chainIntegral ω (R.piece i).boundary) ∧
  (∀ (d : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean (d + 1))) (R T : PositiveRegion (d + 1) E),
    IsOpen E → R.carrier = T.carrier → ChainEq R.boundary T.boundary)

squareBoundary_contract.text:
def squareBoundary_contract : Prop :=
  (squareTriangleMap 0 '' standardSimplex 2) ∪
      (squareTriangleMap 1 '' standardSimplex 2) = (Cell.unit 2).carrier ∧
  (∀ (i : Fin 2) (u : Coord 2), LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ (squareTriangleMap i) u).toLinearMap = 1) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (Φ : Surface 2 n E)
    (hD : Φ.domain = .cell (Cell.unit 2)),
    (∀ ω : FormField n, IsFormOn E 2 ω →
      Φ.domain.Integrable (surfaceIntegrand Φ ω) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, (squareTriangleSurface Φ hD i).domain.Integrable
        (surfaceIntegrand (squareTriangleSurface Φ hD i) ω)) ∧
      surfaceIntegral Φ ω = ∑ i : Fin 2, surfaceIntegral (squareTriangleSurface Φ hD i) ω) ∧
    (∀ ω : FormField n, IsFormOn E 1 ω →
      (∀ (i : Fin 2) (j : Fin 3), (squareTriangleFaceSurface Φ hD i j).domain.Integrable
        (surfaceIntegrand (squareTriangleFaceSurface Φ hD i j) ω)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 4, (rectangleEdgeSurface Φ (Cell.unit 2) hD i).domain.Integrable
        (surfaceIntegrand (rectangleEdgeSurface Φ (Cell.unit 2) hD i) ω)) ∧
      surfaceIntegral (squareTriangleFaceSurface Φ hD 0 0) ω +
        surfaceIntegral (squareTriangleFaceSurface Φ hD 1 0) ω = 0 ∧
      squareTriangularBoundaryIntegral Φ hD ω =
        rectangleBoundaryIntegral Φ (Cell.unit 2) hD ω))

pma10_32_contract.text:
def pma10_32_contract : Prop :=
  sphereRectangleMap '' sphereRectangleCell.carrier = Metric.sphere (0 : Euclidean 3) 1 ∧
  (∀ (E : Set (Euclidean 3)) (hE : MapsTo sphereRectangleMap sphereRectangleCell.carrier E),
    let Φ := sphereRectangleSurface hE
    (rectangleEdgeSurface Φ sphereRectangleCell rfl 0).map =
      (fun u => (coordEquivEuclidean 3) ![Real.sin (u 0), 0, Real.cos (u 0)]) ∧
    (rectangleEdgeSurface Φ sphereRectangleCell rfl 1).map =
      (fun _ => (coordEquivEuclidean 3) ![0, 0, -1]) ∧
    (rectangleEdgeSurface Φ sphereRectangleCell rfl 2).map =
      (fun u => (coordEquivEuclidean 3) ![Real.sin (u 0), 0, -Real.cos (u 0)]) ∧
    (rectangleEdgeSurface Φ sphereRectangleCell rfl 3).map =
      (fun _ => (coordEquivEuclidean 3) ![0, 0, 1]) ∧
    ∀ ω : FormField 3, IsFormOn E 1 ω →
      (∀ i : Fin 4, IteratedRIntegrable (rectangleEdgeCell sphereRectangleCell i)
        (surfaceIntegrand (rectangleEdgeSurface Φ sphereRectangleCell rfl i) ω)) ∧
      surfaceIntegral (rectangleEdgeSurface Φ sphereRectangleCell rfl 1) ω = 0 ∧
      surfaceIntegral (rectangleEdgeSurface Φ sphereRectangleCell rfl 3) ω = 0 ∧
      surfaceIntegral (rectangleEdgeSurface Φ sphereRectangleCell rfl 2) ω =
        -surfaceIntegral (rectangleEdgeSurface Φ sphereRectangleCell rfl 0) ω ∧
      rectangleBoundaryIntegral Φ sphereRectangleCell rfl ω = 0)

pma10_33_contract.text:
def pma10_33_contract : Prop :=
  ∀ (d n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n) (Γ : SimplexChain (d + 1) n E),
    IsOpen E → IsCFormOn 1 E d ω →
      chainIntegral (exteriorDerivative ω) Γ = chainIntegral ω (chainBoundary Γ)

pma10_34_contract.text:
def pma10_34_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n),
    IsExactOn E (k + 1) ω ↔
      ∃ η : FormField n, IsCFormOn 1 E k η ∧ EqOn (exteriorDerivative η) ω E) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n),
    IsClosedOn E k ω ↔ IsCFormOn 1 E k ω ∧ EqOn (exteriorDerivative ω) 0 E) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n),
    IsOpen E → IsCFormOn 1 E (k + 1) ω → IsExactOn E (k + 1) ω → IsClosedOn E (k + 1) ω)

pma10_35_contract.text:
def pma10_35_contract : Prop :=
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n),
    IsOpen E → IsCFormOn 1 E 1 ω →
      (IsClosedOn E 1 ω ↔ ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ i j : Fin n,
        coordinatePartial (formCoefficient ω {j}) x i =
          coordinatePartial (formCoefficient ω {i}) x j)) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n),
    IsOpen E → IsFormOn E 1 ω →
      (IsExactOn E 1 ω ↔ ∃ f : Euclidean n → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f E ∧
        ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ i : Fin n, coordinatePartial f x i = formCoefficient ω {i} x)) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n),
    IsOpen E → IsFormOn E (k + 1) ω → IsExactOn E (k + 1) ω →
      ∀ Γ Δ : SimplexChain (k + 1) n E,
        ChainEq (chainBoundary Γ) (chainBoundary Δ) → chainIntegral ω Γ = chainIntegral ω Δ) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n),
    IsOpen E → IsFormOn E (k + 1) ω → IsExactOn E (k + 1) ω →
      ∀ Γ : SimplexChain (k + 1) n E,
        ChainEq (chainBoundary Γ) 0 → chainIntegral ω Γ = 0) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (ω : FormField n),
    IsOpen E → IsClosedOn E k ω → ∀ Γ : SimplexChain (k + 1) n E,
      chainIntegral ω (chainBoundary Γ) = 0) ∧
  (∀ (k n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclidean n)) (Γ : SimplexChain (k + 2) n E),
    chainBoundary (chainBoundary Γ) = 0 ∧ ChainEq (chainBoundary (chainBoundary Γ)) 0)
